chapter: Edgar Blanchard, Danny White and spot jobbing
title: Playing in Danny White's band
summary: He lists the members of Danny White's band, including Ernest Holland, Curtis Mitchell, Joe Fox and Irving Bannister.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: five years. About four or five years I would imagine. That's what I'm saying. If I could find my other little book that I had around the house. I played with various... I always with somebody, some group. Then I left Edgar and I went, I think I went with Danny's band, Danny White's. Danny White. Yeah, I played with Danny. See, I don't remember who was in the band. I know it was Ernest Holland, he played tenor sax. Probably Curtis Mitchell. Curtis used to do the writing, the arranging. Let me see. It was either Joe Fox or Fox. I'd like you to talk with him, man. Joe Fox is still around? Yeah. He and I, we play together with Wallace. Oh, okay. Okay. Yeah. Nolan Coleman, who was, we used to call Ernest Holland Tran, that was his nickname, Tran. But it was his nephew, he used to play drums with Danny too. So I can't remember which drum it was at the time. What about Irving? Irving Bannister. Irving Bannister was a guitar player. And the guy we call Hawk, I never did know
his real name. I think it was Hawkins, but I know it's Ernest. I think it's Hawkins. Look,
